finalists.name: Roguelike Indoors + Roguelike Characters
finalists.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
finalists.licence: "Creative Commons CC0" (links to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); preview images also say "CC0 1.0 ... Written permission not required, support us by crediting or donating (voluntary)"
finalists.tile_size: Not stated on either page. Believed to be 16x16 with 1px spacing on the sheet, as in the rest of Kenney's Roguelike series, but that is UNVERIFIED
finalists.counts: Indoors: 480 files. Characters: 450 files (page counts only; there are no separate tile counts)

tavern_props.stone_brick_walls: partial: plaster/beige interior walls in the sample; stone not confirmed
tavern_props.bar_counter: partial: long counters and kitchen units
tavern_props.bottle_shelves: partial: shelves and cabinets with items; dedicated bottle shelf not confirmed

finalists.characters: Modular paper-doll system: bodies/skin tones + clothing + hair + headgear + weapons + shields. It can produce dozens of distinct humanoids (ranger, fighter, cleric, hooded stranger and so on). No halfling body type.
finalists.item_icons: Weapons and shields are in the character pack (a bow is likely); no quill, letter or rope seen
finalists.style: Colourful, flat, low-contrast muted pastel, no dark outline, orthographic top-down with front-facing furniture
finalists.gaps: No animations and only one facing direction. Characters must be composited from layers. Tile size is not stated on the page. Unclear whether it has a barrel, fireplace or chest, so Tiny Dungeon may be needed to fill those in. No trapdoor.

finalists.name: Tiny Dungeon + Tiny Town
finalists.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
finalists.counts: Tiny Dungeon: 130 files. Tiny Town: 130 files (page file counts)

tavern_props.wooden_floor: partial: Tiny Town wood-plank wall/facade tiles; Tiny Dungeon floors are sand/stone
tavern_props.stone_brick_walls: yes (grey stone brick walls in both)

finalists.characters: About 16 humanoid sprites in Tiny Dungeon: wizard, knights, rogue, bearded dwarf-like figure, women, hooded figure, plus monsters. Enough for the party and most NPCs if some are reused. No dedicated barkeep, cook or bard.
finalists.item_icons: Potions (several colours), swords, axes, staffs and shields in Tiny Dungeon; key, bow, arrow, tools and bags in Tiny Town. No quill, letter or rope.
finalists.style: Bright, chunky, thick dark outline, 3/4 top-down, warm sand and cool grey palette, consistent across the Tiny series
finalists.gaps: Weak on tavern furniture (no bar, bottle shelf, fireplace or rug), no animations, single-facing characters, small sheet

finalists.name: Ninja Adventure - Asset Pack
finalists.author: Pixel-Boy and AAA
finalists.licence: "They are released under the Creative Commons Zero (CC0) license." ... "Attribution is not required but appreciated." Sidebar: "Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal"
finalists.tile_size: 16x16 per the page tag. The description text does not state a tile size.
finalists.counts: 50+ characters (with animations and faceset), 30+ monsters, 9 bosses, 60+ items, 30+ visual effects, 100+ SFX, 37 music tracks, 2 fonts; tile count not stated

tavern_props.wooden_floor: likely (interior tileset elements stated); not confirmed in screenshots
tavern_props.barrels: not confirmed (pots and crates appear in exterior shots)

finalists.furniture_note: On furniture, the author wrote in a page comment: "It's a bit limited at the moment"
finalists.characters: 50+ distinct humanoid and creature characters (the gallery caption says 56), each with walk/attack-style animations and a portrait faceset. Wide variety: hooded figures, old men, warriors, monks, a chef-like hat. The best candidate for all 9 party and NPC roles.
finalists.item_icons: 60+ items: feather/quill-like, scroll/book, potion-like flasks, arrows, tools, food; key, letter and rope not confirmed
finalists.style: Saturated, colourful, dark outlines, chibi proportions, Zelda-like 3/4 top-down. Ninja/east-Asian flavour on some characters.
finalists.gaps: Interior and tavern furniture is limited by the author's own admission, so tavern props would need supplementing (for example from Kenney Roguelike Indoors, though the styles differ). The ninja theme is a slight mismatch with D&D.

finalists.name: 1-Bit Pack
finalists.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
finalists.counts: 1078 files (page count); includes monochrome and transparent variants

tavern_props.wooden_floor: partial: 1-bit pattern floors; the interior sample uses a plain floor
tavern_props.bar_counter: yes (long tables and counters in the interior sample)
tavern_props.fireplace: possible (stove/hearth-like tile in interior sample); not confirmed
tavern_props.stairs: yes (stair and ladder tiles in the sheet)

finalists.characters: Many 1-bit humanoids in the sheet (dozens): knights, robed and hooded figures, bearded characters, and others. Enough distinct silhouettes for all 9 roles, though they can only be told apart by silhouette and tint.
finalists.item_icons: Large icon set: keys, potions, bows, swords, scrolls, hearts, coins and more; quill, letter and rope plausible but not confirmed
finalists.style: Muted 1-bit: light glyphs on a dark plum background, with orange, green, red and yellow accents. Roguelike/orthographic, no outline.
finalists.gaps: No animations. The minimalist look loses tavern atmosphere, and characters read as icons. Many specific props are unconfirmed without opening the sheet.
